`pyi_rth_setuptools_6_22_3.py` is the unchanged runtime hook from the
PyInstaller 6.22.3 Windows wheel, used only as the native positive control for
the Windows onedir startup correction. Its original copyright and Apache-2.0
notice are retained; the wheel's license file is `PYINSTALLER-COPYING.txt`.

Upstream source:
https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/blob/v6.22.3/PyInstaller/hooks/rthooks/pyi_rth_setuptools.py

The fixture is not collected into the application.
